---
title: "Subfigure References"
format: html
filters:
  - gallimaufry
extensions:
  gallimaufry:
    subfig-ref: true
---

## Parent figure with subfigures

The filter strips the parent prefix from subfigure cross-references inside parent figures.
Instead of "Figure 1 (a)", the reference reads "(a)".

::: {#fig-animals layout-ncol=2}

![A cat](https://placehold.co/300x200?text=Cat){#fig-cat}

![A dog](https://placehold.co/300x200?text=Dog){#fig-dog}

Two animals.
:::

See @fig-animals for both animals, @fig-cat for the cat, and @fig-dog for the dog.
